system_note: Claim MR_SNF_02 - Revenue line 1 billed 0192 (rehabilitation therapy), units=10, DOS range 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-15. Review of the record shows: (1) an interdisciplinary plan of care documenting skilled PT/OT planned 5-7x/week (INTERDISCIPLINARY PLAN OF CARE - SNF STAY, pp. 10-11); (2) a PT evaluation documenting a qualifying prior inpatient hospitalization discharged 06/02/2026 (Physical Therapy, pp. 18-20); and (3) therapy progress notes on ten dates within the billed range documenting high-minute skilled therapy sessions (example: PT progress note documents "Total minutes this session: 90 minutes (6 billable units) | Revenue Code: 0421") that align with the 0192 rehabilitation per-diem level. The payer-specific guideline for Aetna Medicare Advantage was not available in the dataset; the payer-agnostic reference guide confirms the concept of a "skilled need" and maps revenue code 0192 to rehabilitation therapy (Policy Documents/SNF/Reference Materials/SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide.docx, positions 6 and 8). Per-diem-level determination fields returned null for individual dates; the retrieval tool's note explains that a null level_determination_statement commonly means the facility had no exception to document because the billed level's minute threshold was met that day (get_per_diem_level_notes result note). Taken together - documented plan of care calling for frequent skilled PT/OT, a qualifying hospital discharge the day of SNF admission, and repeated PT/OT progress notes showing 90 PT minutes + 60 OT minutes on the ten billed dates - the medical record supports the billed 0192 per-diem level for the ten days billed. Citations: INTERDISCIPLINARY PLAN OF CARE - SNF STAY, pp. 10-11; Physical Therapy evaluation, pp. 18-20; PT progress notes (example p.25); Policy Documents/SNF/Reference Materials/SNF Level of Care - Definitions and Reference Guide.docx, positions 6 and 8; get_per_diem_level_notes result note. Billed line: revenue code 0191, units=3, date range 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-15. Retrieved daily documentation shows substantial therapy minutes on multiple dates within that span (PT 90 min + OT 60 min on 2026-06-02, 06-03, 06-04, 06-05, 06-08, 06-09, 06-10, 06-11, 06-12, 06-15) but no explicit per-diem level determination statements on any date. The dataset's own guidance for the per-diem notes tool states that a null level_determination_statement often indicates the facility did not document an exception because the billed level's threshold was met; conversely, the daily minutes alone are noted as insufficient by themselves to prove the per-diem level without the per-diem-level extraction. Because the revenue line reports 3 billed days across a wide date range, the record must show which SPECIFIC calendar dates were billed at 0191 (so each billed date can be evaluated day-by-day against the payer's per-diem criteria). That mapping is not present in the retrieved rows, and no payer per-diem guideline rows were returned to establish the exact minute/assessment criteria required to support 0191. Therefore I cannot reliably determine whether the three billed days within 6/2-6/15 are fully supported or require downcoding/adjustment; escalate for human review or supply (1) the exact calendar dates the facility billed as 0191 (which of the dates in the range correspond to the 3 units) and (2) the governing per-diem guideline or facility per-diem determination notes to apply the specific level criteria. Citations: see the get_per_diem_level_notes and get_daily_services query results below for the null per-diem statements and the therapy minutes.
hitl_escalation_point: Line 2: Please provide (A) the exact calendar dates within 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-15 that the facility billed at revenue code 0191 (which specific three dates correspond to the 3 billed units), and (B) the payer's per-diem guideline or facility per-diem determination criteria used to assign 0191 (so we can apply the threshold/assessment criteria day-by-day).

level_determination_statement is null on a date when the daily note doesn't state an explicit per-diem-level exception for it - that does NOT by itself mean the day is unsupported; it commonly means the billed level's own minute threshold was met that day, so the facility had no exception to document. A non-null statement is the facility's own basis for downcoding that specific date.

level_determination_statement is null on a date when the daily note doesn't state an explicit per-diem-level exception for it - that does NOT by itself mean the day is unsupported; it commonly means the billed level's own minute threshold was met that day, so the facility had no exception to document.

These are the billed minutes per session - they don't by themselves say which per-diem level a date supports. Call get_per_diem_level_notes for this claim before concluding a date's documentation is insufficient: the facility's own daily note frequently states the level determination outright, and that tool extracts it directly rather than requiring you to guess a search keyword.
